subject.title: Control UI: Memory panel for MEMORY.md and USER.md

question: Should the editable MEMORY.md/USER.md/daily-note experience be a core Control UI memory panel, part of a generic secured workspace-file manager, or a plugin-owned Control UI contribution surface?
rationale: Current main only partially satisfies the request through generic allowlisted files, while the missing daily-note and memory-specific UX crosses security, session-state, and product ownership boundaries.

options.title: Keep Product/Security Review Open
options.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers decide the owner boundary and access model before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Workspace File Manager
options.body: Make the broader workspace-file API/UI the canonical path, then close this only after it lands with memory-note coverage.

options.title: Route Through Plugin UI Slots
options.body: Use this as a motivating memory/context-panel case for the Control UI contribution-slot RFC instead of adding a bespoke core panel.

recommendation.title: Keep Product/Security Review Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers decide the owner boundary and access model before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is security-boundary heavy, and Peter has relevant recent history around the `agents.files` workspace file safety boundary.
